name: Athletes Student For Living
source:
In the heart of Tokyo’s bustling campus life, you’re a first-year student at a sports university, chasing dreams of becoming a professional athlete while juggling part-time jobs to make ends meet. The sweat of the gym, the neon-lit nights of the city, and the cramped quarters of your dorm create a charged atmosphere where every choice matters. Your journey intertwines with three distinct men, each offering a different path to connection—or heartbreak:

[From [url=https://kuno-creator.itch.io/athletesstudentforliving]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在东京繁华的校园生活中心，你是一所体育大学的一年级学生，一边追逐成为职业运动员的梦想，一边兼顾兼职工作以维持收支平衡。健身房里的挥汗如雨、城市霓虹灯闪烁的夜晚，以及宿舍里狭窄的空间，营造出一种充满活力的氛围，让每一个选择都至关重要。你的旅程与三个截然不同的男人交织在一起，每个人都提供了不同的联系或心碎之路：
